title: Comment on Mobile, Alabama Native will be playing bass guitar for Lenny Kravitz this upcoming Fall Festival. by Appliance Repair Manual
text:
Jarvis Pritchett is a Mobile, Alabama native who’s been a fan of Lenny Kravitz since age 5. The day that Jarvis was playing the aucoustic guitar and singing “I love the rain” by Lenny Kravitz at a local cafe in New York where he now lives, Just so happened the same day Lenny’s formal manager was there listen to the smooth southern toned artist. We talked to Jarvis and he says he’s “Very excited to be performing with his idol”. Mobile’s Fall Festival will be held on October 28, 2017. Be sure to come out and support Jarvis and also to see the Afrocentric man Lenny Kravitz himself.
